products.name: Microsoft 365 Mail Hygiene & Anti-Spam — EOP / Defender for Office 365 — Commercial
products.short_description: Configure and tune Microsoft 365 mail hygiene — EOP anti-spam/malware/spoof + Defender for Office 365 anti-phish/Safe Links/Safe Attachments, preset baselines, and quarantine/allow-block policy — so threats are blocked and false positives minimized. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Tune M365 mail hygiene so threats stop and good mail flows

Default mail hygiene lets phishing through and quarantines legitimate mail — both erode trust. This solution configures and tunes Microsoft 365 mail hygiene: Exchange Online Protection (EOP) anti-spam, anti-malware, and connection/spoof filtering, plus Defender for Office 365 anti-phishing, Safe Links, and Safe Attachments where licensed — with quarantine policy, allow/block management, and the recommended (preset/Standard-Strict) baselines — so threats are blocked and false positives are minimized.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the hygiene stack: EOP anti-spam/malware/spoof, Defender for Office 365 (anti-phish, Safe Links/Attachments), preset security policies, and quarantine.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (EXO + EOP/Defender for Office 365 licensing, admin roles, DNS/auth, pilot group).
  • Implementation Guide — apply the baseline (preset or Standard/Strict), tune anti-spam/malware/anti-phish, configure Safe Links/Attachments, set quarantine + allow/block policy, and validate with test messages — pilot-first, each policy named.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Exchange Online PowerShell (EXO V3) / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (threats blocked, false-positive rate low, quarantine reviewed) plus Best Practices for ongoing hygiene tuning and reporting.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Mail hygiene that blocks threats and passes good mail — EOP and Defender for Office 365 tuned to a proven baseline, quarantine governed, false positives down — trust restored.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • Get-MailHygieneAssessment.ps1 — Read-only assessment of the Microsoft 365 mail hygiene posture (EOP + Defender for Office 365)
    • Get-MailHygieneScopeHealth.ps1 — Read-only scope/health helper: resolves which hygiene policy applies to a user (policy precedence),
    • Get-QuarantineAndAllowBlockReport.ps1 — Read-only reporting: quarantine review, Tenant Allow/Block List review (incl. stale/expiring
    • Set-MailHygieneBaseline.ps1 — Configuration helper to apply/tune the mail-hygiene baseline. SAFE BY DEFAULT: dry-run (-WhatIf)
    • Test-MailHygienePolicy.ps1 — Read-only validation of the mail-hygiene baseline: policy presence/scope, quarantine actions,

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
